title: CKA Lab: Expose It, Store It, Lock It Down
description: Break a Service selector and watch endpoints disappear, restore it and reach it via NodePort, prove a PVC's data survives its Pod, then verify least-privilege RBAC in both directions.

steps.title: Expose a Deployment and verify it from inside the cluster
Break the selector on purpose, then watch the endpoints vanish
Repair it, then reach it via NodePort
A ServiceAccount that cannot delete what it can read
